title: Think in Safety: Unveiling and Mitigating Safety Alignment Collapse in Multimodal Large Reasoning Model
reasoning: The paper benchmarks multimodal models on safety and alignment using categories such as discrimination, hate speech, and illegal activities. It explicitly incorporates and evaluates the models based on 'safety regulations' that define requests as 'legal, safe, and ethical,' directly assessing the models' ability to reason through moral and ethical dilemmas in a multimodal context.
